leave_one_season_out.note: Tests stability but uses seasons both before and after the held-out season.

temporal_prior_seasons_only.note: Leakage-safe chronological evaluation using only earlier seasons for each holdout.

limitations: SP+ residuals include remaining SP+ projection error and are not a pure physical stadium effect.
Current site HFA uses 2026 values and is benchmark-only.
FPI and TeamRankings historical files contain direct game projections, not identifiable neutral team ratings, so they are not used to estimate HFA.
Conference estimates use historical conference membership from each game; realignment is preserved by season.
A small MAE improvement is not sufficient by itself for production deployment.
